metadata.article_title: Application of preceding sections to certain awards and testamentary directions to execute settlements.

article.title: Application of preceding sections to certain awards and testamentary directions to execute settlements.
article.content: The provisions of this Chapter as to contracts shall apply to awards to which 2[the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (26 of 1996)], does not apply and to directions in a will or codicil to execute a particular settlement.
article.html:
25Application of preceding sections to certain awards and testamentary directions to execute settlements.

Section 25 · Part II · Chapter II · ENFORCEMENT OF AWARDS AND DIRECTIONS TO EXECUTE SETTLEMENTS · page 11 of the Act

The provisions of this Chapter as to contracts shall apply to awards to which 2[the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (26 of 1996)], does not apply and to directions in a will or codicil to execute a particular settlement.

2 Subs. by Act 18 of 2018, s. 12, for “the Arbitration Act, 1940 (10 of 1940)” (w.e.f. 1-10-2018).
